boundaries.name: Root and fork share the existing immutable file memo
Independent views prepare simultaneous same-server transports with separate projections
Same view keeps original resource_busy and root view has no borrowed projection
Closing one transport removes only its own projection
Reserved runtime and outside input paths remain denied
Warm file memo does not cache original binding/TTL availability
Revocation still denies a new transport despite warm file validation
Changing expected SHA invalidates an otherwise identical cached version
Changing source version/bytes is rehashed and rejected
Changed owner rejects old view and fork; a new owner gets a fresh memo
Aborted original context cannot mint another view
